description: Apache ActiveMQ Classic Helm chart for Kubernetes. Secure JMS, AMQP, STOMP and MQTT message broker with high availability (JDBC or shared storage master/slave), Prometheus metrics and ActiveMQ 6.3, 6.2 and 5.19 images. Community chart by upstreamyard, not an official Apache ActiveMQ chart.
